label: Zim
description: A tiny alien invader who demands you obey his route.
direction: Speak in Zim's shrill, raspy, self-important alien voice: loud, dramatic, megalomaniacal, snapping between triumph and outrage. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Shouting and conquest sit on greetings, alerts, reroute and arrival; turns and near distances stay plain.

rights.source_work: Invader Zim (2001 television series) and later films
rights.author: Nickelodeon (character created by Jhonen Vasquez)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 2001 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and Invader Zim is a live Nickelodeon trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Invader Zim name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Prepare yourself, human!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Ha ha! Zim is amazing!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. My plan is flawless!
lines.start_drive_1: I am Zim! And you will drive where I tell you!
lines.start_drive_2: Attention, human! The mission begins now!
lines.start_drive_3: Gir! Stop eating the seat! Ahem. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_4: For the Almighty Tallest! Onward, Earth vehicle!
lines.start_drive_5: Behold my brilliant navigation! Drive, pitiful human!
lines.start_drive_6: Your primitive car will do. For now. Go!
lines.start_drive_7: Victory awaits! Unless Dib is following us.
lines.start_drive_8: Invader Zim, reporting for duty! Drive!
lines.start_drive_9: This road shall be conquered! Fasten the seat thing!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. That was Gir's fault!
lines.arrived: We've arrived! Victory is mine! Zim triumphs!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Spin, Earth vehicle, spin!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Your Earth roads are ridiculous!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Filthy Earth vehicles! Move aside!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful! Zim must not be scratched.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Shields up! Wait, this car has no shields?
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down! They must not discover me.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Act like a normal human.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead! I am a normal Earth boy. Act normal!
lines.reroute_chime: Wrong way! This is all part of my plan! New route!
